title: Perambulation
summary: PERAMBULA'TION, noun The act of passing or walking through or over. 1. A traveling survey or inspection. 2. A district within which a person has the right of inspection; jurisdiction. 3. Annual survey

inlines.v: PERAMBULA'TION, noun The act of passing or walking through or over. 1. A traveling survey or inspection. 2. A district within which a person has the right of inspection; jurisdiction. 3. Annual survey of the bounds of a parish in England, or of a township in America.
